title: Template check: an unscheduled workout, picked up where you left off
problem: Not a real idea. This record exercises the demo kit on a feature the app already has: starting a workout on a day the schedule doesn't plan, with each exercise's weights filled in from the last time it was logged.

evidence.quote_or_summary: There was no way to start a workout that isn't on the schedule; a New workout picker now starts any active program today.
Opening an exercise fills weight and reps from its own last set, in this session or the most recent earlier one, before falling back to the starting weight.
The fixture lifter's last squat session ended on an AMRAP set of 6 at 155 pounds, which is what the demo should show prefilled.

hypothesis: Started from New workout on an unscheduled day, the fixture lifter's squat opens at the 155 pounds last logged, so a set is logged with one tap and saved to the server.
acceptance_criteria: The video is 60 seconds with sections of 5, 40, 10 and 5 seconds.
The walkthrough starts GZCLP from New workout, shows the squat prefilled at 155, logs a set and finishes the workout.
The finished session reaches the API (the sync push is accepted).
success_signal: The same structure and timings as every other demo, in workout and in violin.
strongest_reason_not_to_build: Nothing to build: it is a test of the demo kit and the template on a full-stack app.
